stories.title: RLP emerges as third force in Rajasthan panchayat polls
stories.summary: Nagaur MP Hanuman Beniwal’s Rashtriya Loktantrik Party has surpassed a 6% vote share in Rajasthan’s panchayat elections. With victories in 497 panchayat samiti seats and 51 zila parishad seats, the party has established a rural presence across multiple districts ahead of the 2028 State Assembly election.

stories.title: MHA sends more central forces to Tripura for municipal polls
stories.summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs has sanctioned 25 additional companies of Central Armed Police Forces for Tripura’s municipal elections on November 27. Combined with local units, 29 companies will remain deployed until after the results are declared on December 2. The opposition had requested the additional security presence.

stories.title: Trade unions and farmers demand apology from PM Modi
stories.summary: Trade unions and farmers’ organisations have demanded an apology from Prime Minister Narendra Modi for the failure of the Make in India and Viksit Bharat 2047 projects. The groups cited the Prime Minister’s own recent remarks regarding corporate failure to increase investment and employment despite receiving tax concessions.

stories.title: Ladakh records 70% turnout in first post-UT panchayat polls
stories.summary: Ladakh recorded a 70.03% turnout for panchayat elections and 52.4% for municipal council polls. The Leh Apex Body expressed dissatisfaction with the timing of the vote, citing ongoing discussions regarding statehood and the Sixth Schedule. The administration described the turnout as overwhelming for the region's first such election.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav introduces laptop-focused campaign slogan
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav has launched the slogan Lathi haregi-Laptop jitega to promote a development-centric agenda. The party aims to highlight a previous government scheme providing laptops to students while attempting to distance itself from allegations of links to anti-social elements made by the BJP.

stories.title: Shivakumar challenges BJP over Upper Bhadra Project grant
stories.summary: Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar has challenged the BJP to secure the release of a ₹5,300 crore grant announced by the Centre for the Upper Bhadra Project. Speaking in the bypoll-bound Hiriyur constituency, he urged voters to boycott BJP and JD(S) leaders if they seek support without results.

stories.title: Congress claims Rajasthan panchayat poll sweep
stories.summary: Rajasthan Congress president Govind Singh Dotasra claimed the party secured a majority in over 269 of 419 Panchayat Samiti seats, compared to 73 for the BJP. Following the results, the Congress has demanded the resignation of Chief Minister Bhajanlal Sharma, alleging the BJP has been completely wiped out.

stories.title: Congress seeks seat pact with SP by December 20
stories.summary: Congress Uttar Pradesh in-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam stated that alliance talks with the Samajwadi Party for next year’s state elections are ongoing. Gautam said the party has strengthened its position in the state and does not view the Owaisi-Azad alliance as a significant electoral threat.

stories.title: Congress signals shift on delimitation bill
stories.summary: The Congress party has indicated a willingness to discuss a fresh delimitation bill, provided the redrawing of constituencies is delinked from the 2027 Census. This marks a change in stance for the party, which previously blocked the legislation due to a lack of consensus on the process.

stories.title: Congress criticises government over SCO dialogue invitation
stories.summary: Congress spokesperson Supriya Shrinate has questioned the government’s decision to invite Pakistan’s Climate Change Minister to the SCO Civilisational Dialogue. The party described the invitation as rubbing salt into the wounds of families affected by the recent Pahalgam attack, citing the red carpet treatment provided to the minister.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav reaches out to Brahmin voters in Gorakhpur
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav visited the family of the late politician Harishankar Tiwari in Gorakhpur. The move is viewed as an attempt to revive Brahmin mobilisation in the political bastion of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, as the party prepares for upcoming electoral contests.

stories.title: Akhilesh power move in Yogi stronghold: A Brahmin card & don-turned-neta Harishankar Tiwari’s legacy
stories.summary: Lucknow: Seeking to revive Brahmin mobilisation in eastern Uttar Pradesh, Samajwadi Party (SP) chief Akhilesh Yadav has made a significant move in CM Yogi Adityanath’s political bastion of Gorakhpur by reaching out to the family of Harishankar Tiwari. During the PDA (Pichhda, Dalit, Alpsankhyak) Yatra in Gorakhpur, Akhilesh visited Tiwari

stories.title: Woman killed in West Delhi house fire
stories.summary: A 40-year-old woman died and two others were critically injured after a fire broke out in a West Delhi home on Saturday. The woman suffered 95% burns, while her son and daughter-in-law were transferred to Safdarjung Hospital. The fire occurred on the first floor of a residential building.

stories.title: Fire at Vijayawada toy factory contained
stories.summary: A fire broke out at a toy and cartoon manufacturing facility in Vijayawada on Saturday morning. Firefighters worked for six hours to contain the blaze, which started on the first floor of the three-storey building. No casualties were reported, and the cause of the fire remains unknown.

stories.title: Odisha orders inquiry into former CM’s foreign visits
stories.summary: The Odisha government has ordered an inquiry into foreign visits made by former Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik and his aide V.K. Pandian to Japan and Italy. The investigation follows allegations from social activists that expenditure details for the trips were suspicious, unclear, and incomplete.

stories.title: Court frames charges against 14 in NEET paper leak case
stories.summary: A Delhi court has formally framed charges against 14 individuals in the NEET paper leak case. The accused, including three public servants engaged by the National Testing Agency, face charges of cheating and criminal breach of trust. All 14 defendants have pleaded not guilty, setting the stage for trial.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi blames government for Manipur liquor deaths
stories.summary: Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi attributed the deaths of 16 people in Manipur to the negligence of the BJP government. He called for strict action against those responsible and requested immediate support for the affected families, describing the incident as a preventable tragedy rather than an accident.

stories.title: Parel Marian Pilgrimage Centre declared a basilica
stories.summary: The Parel Marian Pilgrimage Centre in Kottayam was officially declared a basilica on Saturday. Archbishop Mar Thomas Tharayil led the proclamation, renaming the site the Marth Mariam Immaculate Conception Shrine Basilica. The event coincided with the consecration anniversary of the local church.

stories.title: Teenager used AI to hack military test website
stories.summary: A 14-year-old from Haryana was apprehended for attempting to sell data belonging to 4,000 Agniveer personnel on the dark web. Officials state the boy used AI tools to identify vulnerabilities and hack a test website. The breach was limited to names and addresses of registered users.

stories.title: Delhi Police apprehends 14-year-old for selling Agniveer data
stories.summary: Delhi Police apprehended a 14-year-old boy from Haryana for allegedly hacking a government website and attempting to sell personal data of 4,000 Agniveers on the dark web. The juvenile reportedly listed the information for 500 USD. The data was intended for former personnel seeking employment opportunities.

stories.title: Two dead in Sagar after suspected toxic liquor
stories.summary: Two men have died and a third is hospitalised in Madhya Pradesh following suspected consumption of spurious liquor. Police have sent samples for testing to determine the cause of the incidents. The investigation remains in the early stages.

stories.title: Last rites for Yogi Adityanath’s mother held in Haridwar
stories.summary: The last rites for Savitri Devi, mother of Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, were performed at Chandi Ghat in Uttarakhand on Saturday. The ceremony was attended by family members, seers, and political leaders. Prime Minister Narendra Modi previously offered his condolences to the Chief Minister.

stories.title: Five killed in ambulance crash on Purvanchal Expressway
stories.summary: Five people died on Saturday morning when an ambulance carrying a body collided with a stationary pickup truck on the Purvanchal Expressway in Uttar Pradesh. Police are investigating the crash, which occurred near Gherawan village. The injured were transported to a community health centre.

stories.title: Fifteen die in Manipur amid suspected liquor poisoning
stories.summary: Fifteen people have died and approximately 150 patients are receiving treatment in Manipur’s Chandel district following suspected consumption of spurious alcohol. Local authorities have advised residents to avoid locally brewed beverages of doubtful origin while hospitals continue to manage the influx of patients.

stories.title: AIPC Tamil Nadu to offer professional support to MSMEs
stories.summary: The All India Professionals’ Congress Tamil Nadu chapter plans to provide legal, financial, and technical support to micro, small, and medium enterprises. The initiative aims to assist with regulatory compliance and delayed payments, a sector where 7 lakh crore rupees in dues remain outstanding across India.

stories.title: Tata Group opens 400th hotel in Bengaluru
stories.summary: The Indian Hotels Company Limited has opened its 400th property, Taj Yelahanka, in Bengaluru. The 256-key hotel was developed in partnership with Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited. The Tata Group’s hotel division began its operations with the Taj Mahal Palace in Mumbai in 1903.

stories.title: Skywalk and flyover planned for Konanakunte Cross
stories.summary: The state government is planning a skywalk and a flyover at Konanakunte Cross to manage increasing pedestrian and vehicle traffic. The project follows approval for a flyover earlier this year, with officials directed to ensure the two structures do not obstruct one another.

stories.title: TGSPDCL engineer arrested for bribery in Hyderabad
stories.summary: A sub-engineer with the Telangana Southern Power Distribution Company Limited was arrested by the Anti-Corruption Bureau for allegedly accepting a 30,000 rupee bribe. The official had reportedly demanded the payment to avoid action regarding an electricity theft allegation.

stories.title: NCB busts drug network supplying Delhi to Kashmir
stories.summary: The Narcotics Control Bureau has dismantled an interstate trafficking network supplying pharmaceutical drugs from Delhi to Kashmir. Authorities seized half-a-million capsules and cough syrup bottles. The operation focused on identifying how codeine-based preparations were diverted from the legitimate supply chain into illicit circulation.

stories.title: Youth Congress issues ultimatum to Meta over censorship
stories.summary: The Indian Youth Congress has issued a seven-day ultimatum to Meta, accusing the platform of political censorship and favouring the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party. The protest follows the suspension of social media accounts belonging to the organisation's national president and in-charge.

stories.title: NCB seizes five lakh pharmaceutical units in drug bust
stories.summary: The Narcotics Control Bureau has arrested four suspects in an operation targeting an interstate pharmaceutical drug syndicate. The agency seized over five lakh tablets and bottles containing controlled substances. The investigation is currently tracing the diversion of codeine-based cough syrups from the legal supply chain.

stories.title: BJP and BRS criticise Congress over Meta office vandalism
stories.summary: The BJP and BRS have accused the Congress party of damaging Hyderabad's business reputation following the vandalism of a Meta office by Youth Congress workers. The incident, which occurred on November 20, has prompted questions regarding the safety of corporate operations in the state.

stories.title: Youth Congress vandalises Meta offices
stories.summary: Youth Congress protesters vandalised Meta offices in Hyderabad and Mumbai, alleging the platform suspended the accounts of party officials to silence dissent. The organisation has accused Meta of acting on behalf of the BJP and issued a seven-day ultimatum to the company.

stories.title: Solar energy installations in Tamil Nadu may slow
stories.summary: Industry representatives suggest solar energy installations in Tamil Nadu may decline in 2027. Investors cite escalating costs, a lack of effective single-window approval systems, and the need for further notification regarding the state's Battery Energy Storage System policy. Approvals have reportedly been stalled for six months.

stories.title: Bay of Bengal records three cyclones in three weeks
stories.summary: Three cyclones have formed over the Bay of Bengal within 23 days, including Arnab, Murasu, and Akvan. While the region typically experiences two cyclone seasons, meteorologists note that weakening vertical wind shear as the monsoon withdraws has created conditions conducive to rapid formation.

stories.title: Study records bird species at higher elevations in Gangotri
stories.summary: A study in Uttarakhand’s Gangotri region has recorded 26 bird species at higher elevations than previously documented. The findings highlight shifts in wildlife distribution within the environmentally fragile Himalayan landscape.

stories.title: Amit Shah discusses Siang dam project with protesters
stories.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah stated that concerns regarding the 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project will be resolved through dialogue. While protesters fear displacement and ecological damage, Shah assured that the region's cultural identity and traditions will be safeguarded. The project is intended to aid national development.

stories.title: 15-20% pollution cut, district-level plans, accountability of officials part of CAQM’s 2027 push for Delhi-NCR
stories.summary: Saloni Bhatia is a journalist with over 15 years of experience in reporting and storytelling, with a strong focus on the Delhi government and political developments in the Capital. Over the years, she has closely tracked policy decisions, governance issues, and political shifts. She started off as an entertainment journalist

stories.title: Supreme Court orders state grievance committees for wetlands
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has directed all states to establish grievance committees under the 2017 Wetland Conservation Rules. The order follows petitions from environmentalists and an organization regarding the demarcation and preservation of wetlands. Public complaints concerning encroachment on these areas are now to be formally addressed.

stories.title: Arunachal groups demand halt to Siang mega dam
stories.summary: Two organizations have submitted a memorandum to Union Home Minister Amit Shah seeking to scrap the 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project. They allege a lack of transparency and intimidation of protesters, requesting a judicial inquiry into recent violence and an immediate halt to all pre-feasibility activities.

stories.title: "Traditions Won't Be Compromised": Amit Shah To Arunachal Dam Protestors
stories.summary: Amit Shah is scheduled to chair a high-level review meeting at Lok Bhavan in Itanagar on Saturday.

stories.title: NGT orders probe into waste dumping near saffron fields
stories.summary: The National Green Tribunal has formed an expert committee to inspect a municipal dumping site in Pampore following allegations that waste is threatening local saffron fields. The committee must submit a report within eight weeks. Saffron cultivation in the region has declined by nearly 35 percent over recent years.

stories.title: India and Bulgaria review bilateral cooperation
stories.summary: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar and his Bulgarian counterpart Velislava Petrova reviewed bilateral ties in trade, security, and technology. The discussions also covered the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor, the Black Sea situation, and the conflict in Ukraine. The two nations noted growing cultural exchanges and people-to-people linkages.

stories.title: India, Canada wrap up sixth round of trade talks ahead of Modi's visit next month
stories.summary: Rajeev Jayaswal is a senior journalist, author and communication strategist with over three decades of experience covering India's economy, energy, trade and public policy. He is Senior Editor at Hindustan Times and author of The Lobbyists, recognised for insightful reporting, in-depth analysis and policy-focused journalism. India, Canada wrap up sixth

stories.title: ‘Want to return, but can’t without safety’: Rohingyas in India react to ICJ ruling on Myanmar genocide
stories.summary: A principal correspondent, Ravi Krishnan Khajuria is the bureau chief at Jammu. With nearly 25 years of experience with Hindustan Times, The Tribune and Kashmir Times, he covers politics, defence, crime, terrorism, Indo-Pak border skirmishes, legislative assembly proceedings, health and civic and environmental issues for Jammu region. stories.title: ICJ verdict noted, India consistently supported speedy return of Rohingya people: MEA
stories.summary: New Delhi, A day after the UN's top court ruled that Myanmar "committed genocide" against the Rohingya group in 2017, India on Friday said it has "taken note of the verdict" and asserted that New Delhi "consistently supported" the safe, speedy and sustainable return of the displaced Rohingya people from

stories.title: Lufthansa to cut 1,000 jobs amid rising costs
stories.summary: Lufthansa plans to cut 1,000 full-time jobs in Frankfurt and Munich as energy costs from the Iran war contribute to monthly losses of 20 million euros. The airline stated that previous cost-cutting measures are no longer sufficient to stem the financial decline of the carrier.

stories.title: India backs Rohingya return to Myanmar after ICJ’s genocide ruling following seven-year proceedings
stories.summary: The UN’s top court ruled by nine votes to six that Myanmar’s 2017 military campaign against the Rohingya amounted to genocide. India on Friday responded to the International Court of Justice (ICJ)’s ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya by saying that it had consistently backed the displaced minority’s

stories.title: India contacts Qatar regarding hospitalized former Navy officer
stories.summary: India has contacted Qatari authorities to ensure the well-being of Purnendu Tiwari, a former Navy officer currently detained on espionage charges. Reports indicate Tiwari has been hospitalized. The officer was among eight former personnel sentenced to death in 2023, a sentence that was later commuted.

stories.title: India declines comment on Tarique Rahman’s ‘across the border’ jibe over Bangladesh unrest
stories.summary: Rezaul Hasan Laskar is Foreign Editor with the Hindustan Times, which he joined in 2015. He began as a journalist in his hometown of Shillong in northeast India and has worked in newspapers and wire services over the years. He moved to New Delhi in 1997 and initially focused on

stories.title: 'China Backed Pakistan During Operation Sindoor To Curb India's Rise': US Panel
stories.summary: The US panel pointed out that China's sharpest tool to deter India is economic.

stories.summary: The US panel report says China is using military, maritime and economic pressure to constrain India's rise, while strengthening its support for Pakistan Chinaâs military support to Pakistan during the May 2025 India-Pakistan conflict added to New Delhiâs security challenges and raised concerns about a possible two-front threat, a US

stories.title: CJI Surya Kant says AI bans are not wise
stories.summary: Chief Justice of India Surya Kant stated that a ban on artificial intelligence is neither practicable nor wise. The comments come as the judiciary navigates the integration of technology into legal systems and public policy, following years of high-profile rulings on constitutional and electoral reforms in India.

stories.title: FBI database hacked again
stories.summary: The FBI database has been hacked for the second time in recent months. The breach was noted in the latest morning briefing, which also covered sports milestones. The agency has not provided further details regarding the security incident or the extent of the compromised information.

stories.title: Teenager held for attempting to sell Agniveer personnel data
stories.summary: A 14-year-old boy from Haryana was apprehended for allegedly hacking a test website to steal data of 4,000 Agniveers. The juvenile reportedly attempted to sell the information on the dark web for 500 USD. The site was designed for former personnel to register for government jobs.

stories.title: Apple shifts strategy to develop autonomous AI agents
stories.summary: Apple is developing an autonomous AI agent capable of executing multi-step tasks across applications and devices. The company aims to enter a market currently led by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta. The shift moves Apple from integrating intelligence into existing products toward building systems that browse the internet.

stories.title: Prince William announces insurance for wildlife rangers
stories.summary: Prince William and the Royal Foundation announced a five-year accident insurance programme for 10,000 temporary wildlife rangers across seven Indian states. The initiative, starting in December 2026, provides financial protection for rangers and their families in the event of death or serious injury sustained while on duty.

stories.title: India reaches 10 million HPV vaccine doses
stories.summary: India has administered over 10 million HPV vaccine doses in nine months, covering 87 percent of its target cohort of 14-year-old girls. Six states have achieved 100 percent coverage under the national campaign. The government provides the single-dose vaccine free of charge to the identified target population.

stories.title: Child rights panel investigates mercury poisoning from cream
stories.summary: The Kerala State Commission for Protection of Child Rights registered a case after a 17-year-old girl developed kidney failure. The teenager reportedly used a fairness cream purchased online for a year. Laboratory tests confirmed the product contained excessive levels of mercury, which led to the acute ailment.

stories.title: India hits 87 percent of HPV vaccination target
stories.summary: India has administered 10 million HPV vaccine doses in nine months, reaching 87 percent of its target population of 14-year-old girls. The Union Health Ministry reported that six states have achieved full coverage. The national campaign provides the single-dose vaccine free of charge to the public.

stories.title: Supreme Court seeks government response on consanguineous marriage
stories.summary: The Supreme Court sought the Centre's response to a petition regarding the health risks of marriages between blood relatives. The court noted that while restricting such unions is a matter for Parliament, it is considering whether public outreach could promote awareness of the associated genetic health risks.

stories.title: Private hospitals report majority of births via C-section
stories.summary: Data from the 2023/24 National Family Health Survey indicates that 54 percent of deliveries in India's private sector are Caesarean sections. The rate is notably higher in major cities like Mumbai, Delhi-NCR and Bengaluru, where a majority of mothers are aged 30 or older at the time of birth.

stories.title: Pregnant woman dies of suspected dengue in Erode
stories.summary: A 39-year-old woman died at Coimbatore Medical College Hospital on Thursday while undergoing treatment for suspected dengue. The patient, who was seven months pregnant, had initially sought care at a private hospital before being transferred for advanced treatment. Her death has prompted concern among local residents.

stories.title: Expert group calls for rabies action plan
stories.summary: Participants at a seminar on the One Health approach stated that a comprehensive policy is required to make Kerala rabies-free by 2030. The event, organised by the Indian Medical Association and the Indian Veterinary Association, emphasised the need to involve local self-governments in prevention and control efforts.

stories.title: Why a shortage of clinical psychologists in Keralam govt hospitals is leaving people with intellectual disabilities wait
stories.summary: The Hindu Why a shortage of clinical psychologists in Keralam govt hospitals is leaving people with intellectual disabilities waiting for certificates As per the last Kerala Disability Census in 2015, there are about 80,000 persons with various intellectual challenges. However, government hospitals and medical college hospitals in the State currently

stories.title: Leptospirosis deaths reported in Ernakulam
stories.summary: Three deaths due to leptospirosis were reported in Ernakulam during November, the highest in the state. Health experts are urging caution as dengue cases also remain prevalent, with 114 confirmed cases reported in the district. Influenza cases, meanwhile, have begun to show a decline.

stories.title: AERB grants criticality nod to Rajasthan nuclear unit
stories.summary: The Atomic Energy Regulatory Board granted permission for the first approach to criticality for unit-8 of the Rajasthan atomic power project. The clearance follows safety reviews of the 700 MWe pressurised heavy water reactor, moving the facility closer to commercial electricity generation.

stories.title: Kalpakkam nuclear centre conducts emergency drill
stories.summary: The Department of Atomic Energy centre in Kalpakkam conducted an unannounced emergency preparedness exercise on Friday. More than 7,000 personnel were evacuated during the simulated response, which was completed in 90 minutes. The annual drill is designed to assess the response capabilities of the facility's various plants.

stories.title: International team builds landslide warning system for Idukki
stories.summary: Researchers from the University of Mississippi, Michigan Technological University and the University of Kerala have developed an automated system to forecast slope failures in Idukki. The Google Earth Engine-based Landslide Early Warning System, or GLEWS, uses real-time data to monitor potential disasters during the monsoon season.

stories.title: Robert Pattinson cast as James Bond
stories.summary: Robert Pattinson has been announced as the next James Bond, sparking debate among digital platforms regarding his suitability for the role. While some critics point to his previous franchise work as a weakness, others suggest his established career makes him a significant departure from his predecessors.

stories.title: US Mint releases Trump gold coin
stories.summary: The US Mint has released a 24K gold proof coin priced at $4,890. The coin contains one troy ounce of gold, which had a market value of $3,514 on November 20. The Mint has not provided an itemized breakdown for the $1,376 price difference.

stories.title: Melania Trump discusses advice for son
stories.summary: In her new Prime Video docuseries, Melania Trump said she advises her 20-year-old son Barron to be careful because it is a dangerous world. She noted that they maintain open communication and that she remains available to provide input whenever he requests it.

stories.title: Taryn Manning identified as GTA 6 voice actress
stories.summary: Taryn Manning has been identified as the voice actress for the recurring Vice City club character Vicki in Grand Theft Auto VI. Manning, known for roles in Hustle and Flow and 8 Mile, began her career with minor television appearances in the late 1990s.

stories.title: GTA 6 launch triggers wider economic ripple effects
stories.summary: The release of Grand Theft Auto VI is expected to be one of the largest entertainment launches in history. Beyond direct game sales for Take-Two Interactive, the title is driving commercial activity across gaming accessories, food delivery, music streaming, merchandise and digital advertising sectors.

stories.title: The rise of Hyundai founder Chung Ju-yung
stories.summary: Chung Ju-yung built the Hyundai business empire after starting as a laborer and facing multiple business losses, including a fire and the Korean War. He eventually expanded into construction, automobiles and shipbuilding, transforming the company into a global industrial powerhouse from his origins in a farming family.
